research.name: ProteinView
research.note: Terminal viewer for PDB/mmCIF molecular structures that draws 3D cartoon ribbons in braille or Kitty/Sixel pixel graphics.

effects: 3D protein cartoon ribbons rendered as pixel graphics inside a terminal TUI
three render tiers of the same structure: braille outline, shaded braille, full pixel graphics
chain interface view with highlighted contact residues, contact sidebar and dashed interaction lines
